name: Zeppole di San Giuseppe
description: Light choux pastry fritters deep-fried or baked and topped with custard cream and a glossy amarena cherry.
ingredients: a handful of fresh rosemary, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with unsalted butter.
In a large bowl, whisk together the spaghetti and cracked black pepper until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the balsamic vinegar with the dry white wine until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 25 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
tips: For the cleanest slices, chill the finished dessert thoroughly before cutting.
This keeps well for a couple of days in an airtight container, and the flavor often improves overnight.
Resist opening the oven door too early — a sudden change in temperature can cause the dessert to sink or crack.
